QuestInfo.name: Questionable Allegiance
QuestInfo.0: You met with Nobunaga's man outside Honnou-ji, but what does he really want? Go find out.
QuestInfo.1: Hideyoshi claims to want to defect to the alliance, along with Tokugawa Ieyasu, but your meeting was cut short by a legion of Nobunaga's troops. Take care of them before speak with him again.
QuestInfo.2: Nobunaga has eyes everywhere. You beat his troops, but more will be coming.
